hints.title: Dynamic Directed Graph
hints.text: Maintain an adjacency list representation of directed edges with positive weights.

hints.title: Adding Directed Edges
hints.text: Appends the new edge directly into the outgoing adjacency list for the source vertex.

hints.title: Shortest Path Query via Min-Cost Search
hints.text: Use a priority exploration mechanism from node1 to find the minimal cumulative distance to node2, stopping early when reaching node2.

hints.title: Dijkstra Priority Queue Implementation

complexity.time: O(E log V) per shortest path query, O(1) per addEdge
complexity.notes: Adjacency list with min-priority queue Dijkstra calculation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force path exploration without priority queue leads to exponential branch exploration.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory to maintain graph connectivity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs clear adjacency list structure and implements standard Dijkstra with early exit.
